package.description: A modern, beautiful, and fully-featured web dashboard for Mihomo (Clash Meta), available as a cross-platform desktop app with a bundled kernel

en-US.description: A modern, beautiful, and fully-featured web dashboard for Mihomo (Clash Meta), available as a cross-platform desktop app with a bundled kernel
en-US.longDescription: metacubexd is the official web dashboard for Mihomo (Clash Meta). The desktop app bundles the dashboard with the mihomo kernel and a local agent, providing real-time traffic monitoring and statistics, proxy group management with latency testing, connection tracking and management, a rule viewer with search functionality, live log streaming, and 32 selectable themes with user color overrides. The dashboard is also available as a hosted panel or an all-in-one Docker server.
en-US.name: MetaCubeXD
en-US.releaseNotes:
1.274.4 (2026-11-04)
Bug Fixes
- desktop: avoid duplicate __dirname declaration in main bundle (#2241) (62aa58f)
- desktop: use static AppImage runtime toolset to avoid libfuse2 dependency (#2242) (42788e2)

zh-CN.description: 一个现代化、美观且功能完备的 Mihomo（Clash Meta）网页仪表盘，提供内置内核的跨平台桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription: metacubexd 是 Mihomo（Clash Meta）的官方网页仪表盘。桌面应用内置 Mihomo 内核与本地代理服务，提供实时流量监控与统计、带延迟测试的代理组管理、连接跟踪与管理、支持搜索的规则查看器、实时日志流，以及 32 种可选主题和自定义配色。该仪表盘也提供托管面板和一体化 Docker 服务器两种部署方式。
